title: Pure Empowered Warrior
summary: Empowered Warrior is a Pendulum and Rank 4/6 Xyz archetype led by Empowerment, Dragodies, the Empowered Warrior, and Dragonox, the Empowered Warrior. Empowerment discards a card each turn to summon any Empowered Warrior directly from the Deck, setting up Pendulum Scales to Pendulum Summon Aether, the Empowering Dragon (which banishes a monster on the field every time it is Pendulum Summoned).

allow.Reinforcement of the Army: Searches any Level 4 Empowered Warrior monster from the Deck (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Terraforming: Searches the essential Empowerment Field Spell (1 copy, Limited in TCG).
allow.Beyond the Pendulum: Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches Dragodies or Dragonox to complete your Pendulum Scales and pops 2 cards on the field.
allow.Majester Paladin, the Ascending Dracosla: Rank 4 Xyz made with Level 4 Pendulum Empowered Warriors that searches any Pendulum Monster during the End Phase.

main: Scale 2 Level 4 LIGHT Warrior Pendulum that halves an attacking monster's ATK in the Pendulum Zone, and searches any Warrior or Spellcaster with 2000 or less ATK during the End Phase if destroyed.

Scale 7 Level 4 DARK Warrior Pendulum that ends the Battle Phase when an opponent attacks in the Pendulum Zone, and discards 1 card on the field to revive a Warrior or Spellcaster with 2000 or less ATK in face-down Defense Position.
Level 6 LIGHT Dragon Pendulum boss that targets 1 card on the field and returns it to the hand whenever it is Normal or Special Summoned.
Level 6 DARK Dragon Pendulum boss that targets 1 monster on the field and banishes it whenever it is Normal or Special Summoned.
Level 4 FIRE Warrior that Special Summons a Spellcaster with 1500 or less ATK from the Deck when destroyed by battle.
Level 4 EARTH Warrior that Special Summons a Level 4 or lower Normal Monster or Warrior from your hand in Defense Position when Normal Summoned.
Level 3 WATER Warrior Flip monster that destroys 1 Spell or Trap Card your opponent controls when flipped face-up (synergizing with Dragonox's face-down revival!).
Level 5 WIND Warrior that can attack your opponent directly and recovers a Dragon, Warrior, or Spellcaster Normal Monster from the GY when sent from field to GY.

Core Field Spell that boosts all Dragon, Warrior, and Spellcaster monsters you control by 300 ATK/DEF and discards 1 card once per turn to Special Summon ANY 'Empowered Warrior' monster directly from your Deck.
Searches Dragodies, Dragonox, Arnis, or Terratiger.
extra: Link-2 Pendulum monster that searches Aether, Dragodies, or Dragonox and destroys 2 cards on the field.
Rank 4 Warrior Xyz made with Dragodies and Dragonox that searches Aether, the Evil Empowering Dragon during the End Phase.
